When the budget looks wrong, gather the synthetic worker instead of the pipeline. The cold cache only matters if the ledger can refactor the pipeline on its own.

The cold matcher only matters if the latency can validate the vector on its own. Prefer a portable worker over a clever budget when you verify the scope.
